result.reason: The clause largely tracks the preferred position: it creates a mutual $1 million/12-month cap and includes all required uncapped carve-outs. However, it does not use the specified cap base or lookback: “amounts paid or payable between the Parties” is broader than fees, and the period precedes the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself. It also excludes every Party’s Section 5 payment obligations from the cap, whereas the playbook only requires Customer payment obligations to be excluded. These deviations make the revision broader than necessary, although it otherwise preserves the existing consequential-damages allocation and is professionally drafted.
